verdict.rationale: Extend documents zero data retention options, including ZDR with its AI subprocessors configurable at the workspace level, plus configurable retention policies and BYOC/VPC deployment. Together these strongly limit downstream model training on customer data, but the pack has no explicit statement that customer data is never used to train Extend's own or third-party models. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out, clarity on whether ZDR is available on all tiers, and independent corroboration.
